The Library is the canonical public index. HTML is the preferred format for
online reading; PDFs are provided for printing and annotation. Release 1
contains Chapters 01–04 only and does not publish standalone computing
supplements.

{{< include _generated/library.qmd >}}

## How QMSBR works in class {#classroom-examples}

This reviewed PDF is a representative classroom-use example—not a public
archive of every lecture note. Instructors may distribute other course-selected
notes to enrolled students through Moodle.

## Coming later {#coming-later}

The titles below describe registered roadmap modules. They are not download
links and do not imply release readiness.

{{< include _generated/roadmap.qmd >}}

Part Two is reserved for factor analysis/SEM, and Part Three for multilevel and
longitudinal models. Part Four and later collections can be registered when
their scope is clear. Empty parts remain absent until materials are authored
and reviewed.
